description_en: Binds a mobile phone number to a member of the resource account type in a resource directory for security purposes
description_zh: 调用BindSecureMobilePhone为资源账号类型的成员设置安全手机号码
name: BindSecureMobilePhone

parameters.help_en:
The verification code.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html operation to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh:
验证码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verification_code

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number that you want to bind to the member for security purposes.

The mobile phone number you specify must be the same as the mobile phone number that you specify when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html operation to obtain a verification code.

Specify the mobile phone number in the \<Country code>-\<Mobile phone number> format.

Mobile phone numbers in the `86-<Mobile phone number>` format in the Chinese mainland are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
安全手机号码。

该手机号码必须与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/372556.html中获取验证码时设置的手机号码一致。

格式：<国家码>-<手机号码>。

<props="china">
仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>


<props="intl">
不支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>
parameters.name: secure_mobile_phone

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member
parameters.name: account_id
